title: The secret bloodline of Jesus, guarded for 1,000 years… by a con man with a typewriter ⌨️
caption:
The Priory of Sion behind The Da Vinci Code was a hoax. He admitted it in court. 🗝️
Tag the friend who believed The Da Vinci Code 👇
